facts.fact: A member with 10 or more years of service who has not reached age 58 is mandatorily issued an EPS scheme certificate
facts.quote: A member whose service is 10 years or more and not attained the age of 58 years will be mandatorily issued scheme certificate.

summary: EPFO FAQ still states the 10-years/under-58 mandatory scheme certificate rule; the Employees' Pension Scheme, 2026 (G.S.R. 527(E), 29.06.2026), which replaced EPS 1995, keeps scheme certificates for members leaving before superannuation (para 12(10)); confirmed.
